final_h4_rule.fail_rule: rank correlation is non-negative or fewer than two Pareto points exist; other results are inconclusive
final_h4_rule.pass_rule: rank correlation is at most -0.35 with at least three Pareto points spanning 5 percentage points and 5 steps
final_h4_rule.title: Detection trade-off

final_h5_rule.fail_rule: either reduction is non-positive or retained coverage is below 25%; intermediate evidence is inconclusive
final_h5_rule.pass_rule: ThetaShield reduces raw-markout false positives and oscillation with lower intervals above zero while retaining at least 50% toxic-premium coverage
final_h5_rule.title: Manipulation resistance

selection_order: H5 candidates are filtered by training guardrails, then ordered by smallest dead-band distance from 1.0, preference for 3-of-5 persistence, fastest permitted relaxation, smallest step-up, and case id. Holdout is evaluated once and never used for selection.
